Great Noodles!
Feb 2018 • Solo
One of my favourite places to eat noodles in HCM. Not always easy to find a seat but it is well worth it to squeeze in and choose from the simple menu.
Many locals eat here regularly... always a good sign
The menus are easy to navigate for English speakers and everything else about the place is simple, basic and no fuss good value.
If you are looking for a 5 star white tablecloth dining experience don't come here!
But for delicious, cheap noodles I recommend!

One of the best noodle soup in HCMC
Jun 2017
Thanks to a colleague who came with a local and recommended to me, my wife and I visited for our breakfast.

Located not far from Banh Thanh market, opposite a Hindu temple, this place was packed on sunday breakfast.

We ordered 2 bowls of rice noodle, one with sliced pork and another with mixed ingredients - liver, kidney, sliced pork and minced pork. I believe you can ask for only one of these ingredients as well.

Besides thin rice noodles, you can also choose noodles and rice vermecilli. I noticed around me the locals were having noodle soup, noodle dry as well as rice noodle soup.

Broth was clear, great flavour and umami, making it the best we had so far for vietnamese noodles in vietnam.

If you are to have only one bowl of noodles in HCMC, this would be one of those you must try!

Average Hu Tieu
May 2015 • Friends
A wonderfully humid, hole in the wall experience. This was the first place I ate at arriving to Ho Chi Minh city.

They have great reviews but I was not amazed by the noodle soup. The delicate broth and the cha lua (Vietnamese salami) doesn't leave you with a craving desire to come back. The little wontons in the soup are tasty though! The locals seem to disagree because the place was super busy.

Overall, decent hu tieu experience but I wouldn't rave about it. To each their own I guess!

One of the best meal i ate in HCM
Jan 2016 • Solo
My friend did some homework and brought me to this place.Be there early if you can cos apparently it only starts in the morning and ends around 2pm. The pork broth is simply divine and the slice pork meal are just some ...tasty. The slices of lean pork meat together with the soup broth are just a perfect match! Ordering is quite simple. Choose your noodles type, soup base and the meal type. Fret not if you do not speak Viet as the lady will pass you the menu.Just point your selection and they will do the rest. It is very near Ben Thanh Market and definitely a must go place if you wish to try great local food.!
